query:
Find applicable evidence-backed ways to reduce execution time in this GitHub Actions workflow. Consider its jobs, dependencies, commands, triggers, and repository manifests.
name: CI

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
      - 'feat/**'
  merge_group:
    types: [ checks_requested ]
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * 0' # at midnight of each sunday
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  skip-check:
    permissions:
      actions: write
      contents: read
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      should_skip: ${{ steps.skip_check.outputs.should_skip }}
    steps:
      - id: skip_check
        uses: fkirc/skip-duplicate-actions@v5
        with:
          cancel_others: true
          paths_ignore: '["*.md"]'

  python:
    needs: skip-check
    if: needs.skip-check.outputs.should_skip != 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: taiki-e/install-action@just
      - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v7
      - run: just ci-python

  rust-msrv:
    needs: skip-check
    if: needs.skip-check.outputs.should_skip != 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: taiki-e/install-action@just
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@master
        with:
          toolchain: 1.96.0 # MSRV
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
      - run: just test

  rust:
    needs: skip-check
    if: needs.skip-check.outputs.should_skip != 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    continue-on-error: ${{ contains(matrix.toolchain, 'nightly') }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        toolchain:
          - stable
          - nightly
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: taiki-e/install-action@just
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@master
        with:
          toolchain: ${{ matrix.toolchain }}
          components: rustfmt, clippy
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
      - run: just spdx-check
      - run: just link-license-check
      - run: just ci-rust
      # The workspace commands above build everything with --all-features, so a
      # default build is never checked for the optional HTTP/3 dependencies, and
      # the feature is never checked without the binary feature.
      - name: Check s3s-fs feature subsets
        run: |
          # `grep -c` exits 1 when it matches nothing, so capture the counts before
          # asserting on them instead of relying on its exit code.
          default_count=$(cargo tree -p s3s-fs | grep -cE 'quinn|h3 v' || true)
          http3_count=$(cargo tree -p s3s-fs --features http3 | grep -cE 'quinn|h3 v' || true)
          test "$default_count" = 0
          test "$http3_count" -gt 0
          cargo check -p s3s-fs --all-targets
          cargo build -p s3s-fs --no-default-features --features http3

  cross-test:
    needs: skip-check
    if: needs.skip-check.outputs.should_skip != 'true'
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os:
          - windows-latest
          - macos-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: taiki-e/install-action@just
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
      - run: just test

  wasm-test:
    needs: skip-check
    if: needs.skip-check.outputs.should_skip != 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: taiki-e/install-action@just
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
      - uses: taiki-e/install-action@wasm-pack
      - uses: taiki-e/install-action@wasm-bindgen-cli
      - name: wasm-pack test

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check

        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run
